entries.subject: Albedo and Monochrome
entries.finding: The live NASA SVS 5069 source page was examined against the selected release filenames. It separately supplies the 6.25 cm zero-phase albedo and 5 cm PolyCam basemap, with distinct acquisition/control and photometric histories. The selected package keeps them separate; SVS’s example blend is not a single calibrated albedo dataset.

entries.subject: Spectral composite
entries.finding: [USGS MapCam](https://astrogeology.usgs.gov/search/map/bennu-osiris-rex-ocams-photometric-mosaics-25cm), [DellaGiustina et al. 2020](https://figshare.com/articles/journal_contribution/Maps_DellaGiustina_et_al_Science_2020_abc3660/12996494). False color: red x/v (847/550 nm), green 698 nm band strength, blue b′/v (473/550 nm); no mineral abundance is inferred.

entries.subject: Shape and Elevation
entries.finding: [OLA v20 PTM](https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a000000/a005000/a005069/g_00880mm_alt_ptm_0000n00000_v020.obj); radius minus 241 m, not gravitational height.

entries.subject: OLA v21 and 5 cm local shape tiles
entries.finding: SVS lists a 17.9-million-polygon OLA v21 model, alongside selected 3.4-million-polygon v20, and directs users to SBMT for the full 5 cm tile collection. These are concrete higher-detail candidates. They were identified from the release page, not downloaded or qualified for the current prepared budget and map frame.
entries.revisitWhen: A bounded source comparison demonstrates useful visible detail and map compatibility for a selected model or tile within the established geometry and payload budget.

entries.subject: SVS blended texture and printing models
entries.finding: The page describes filling albedo-map polar gaps with a differently normalized image basemap. It also labels sample-site meshes modified for printing, with changed scale/centering and modeled post-TAG offsets. These visualization derivatives are not adopted as unchanged measurement inputs.
entries.revisitWhen: A scientific use explicitly requires the derivative, with its modifications and original source correspondence preserved.

entries.subject: Four MapCam wavelength maps
entries.finding: The USGS v2 ZIP supplies four original float32 GeoTIFFs at 473, 550, 698 and 847 nm with a common cartographic grid. All four are included as one Reflected light group on the existing OLA v20 display shape. A fixed 0–0.08 I/F grayscale range preserves inter-band brightness differences. Independent native-byte probes pass; gaps remain missing and source extremes clip only for display. Physical map-to-shape registration and the existing display-lighting model are not newly qualified.
